review.notes: Full review. Sample: all 15 seeded targets read against the cached texts (67 locators in 14 sources, all at the stated place); adversarial table of 29 rows with computed values, including brute-force Gauss sums and the closed form of Gamma(c). Gate: every check passes; depcheck 0 problems; outside-folder diff empty. Elaboration: 10 sorry warnings only; 11 signatures match the README; one-tactic probe closes none of the 10 theorems. 48 cross-roadmap sections and the cited library declarations resolved at main, the open heads and the pins. Pull-request text agrees with the head. Two source issues recorded (goldmakherlouvel2013 Remark 3, kubota1968 p. 265).
